approved: Frames K-boy and K-girl (K2: single bed in the window corner, desk + chair, bookshelf, ceiling + wall light, sage / clay-pink colour block) with their slots approved 2026-10-08 (verbatim: "סבב 2 נראה מעולה", on assets/blockout/house/framing/round2/all-round2.jpg, tiles K2-boy and K2-girl), with the density decision (verbatim: "כתוב מינימום מוצרים..לדעתי כמה שיותר שהמעצב יחליט שזה לא גורע. ו3 וואריציות מתאימות לנורדי לכל מוצר"). 1.0 includes the clay fixes of the toy basket, doll pram, desk chair and prints (designer nudges, house-plan frame_fixes_1_1_x). Rules: docs/design-bible/nordic.md 1.6 (rooms: kids, incl. the girl palette exception and the toy safety gate); geometry: docs/house-plan.md/json 1.1 (6.6).
notes: One file for both rooms: identical shell, furniture, camera and slot positions; the girl room is the boy room shifted exactly +3.63 in Y. plan_m is given for the boy room (girl: add 3.63 to every Y). Slots with 'rooms' exist in one room only. placement uses the product-card enum; placement_detail names the surface. z = layer order bottom to top; shadow at z-1 unless has_shadow_layer is false. envelope_cm = max envelope per variant; 3 variants within +-15%. frames = master frames where the product is visible by design. Every toy and kid product passes the safety gate (Bible 1.6) before rating. hotspot and zoom_frame after the shell render.

density.rule: Bible 1.7 S11: lean frame, minimum 11 is a floor; as many as the designer judges do not detract (the right side is already the busy side: no additions). Counted (rule D1, 2026-10-10) = a slot whose product is >= 50% visible and covers >= 0.5% of the frame; a set counts once; not counted: fillers, shell, fixed furniture (incl. fixed-product). The counts below were estimated under the rejected 1.6 wording; counts under this rule: docs/proposals/density-after-d1.md.

K-boy.note: rug, roman-blind and bedding count as deliberately cut or partly covered textiles (4.8%, 2.9%, 2.4% of the frame)
